verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe API-driven payment flows: the Checkouts API, auth/capture/partial capture/void control, transfers and payouts, deposit destinations, and webhooks. Access is through an official SDK on GitHub and a CLI whose MCP server exposes every API endpoint as a tool, and an llms.txt index (515 pages) is live. The OpenAPI probes returned 404 at all common paths, so no machine-readable spec was found. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, explicit API reference/auth documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
